changelog: More sources for unrated items: Apple Music (iTunes Search) explicit flags; LRCLIB lyrics (instrumentals are clean, lyrics checked against a configurable word list); fan edits rated from their source film/show; optional foreign-to-US rating mapping; items previously marked Unrated are re-checked.
description: Fills in missing parental ratings for music (Deezer), movies & shows (TMDb), and anime (MyAnimeList) so parental controls work across the whole library.
name: Chaperone
overview: Automatic parental ratings across music, movies, shows, and anime.
